load_feature_extractor_from_pretrained: load a pretrained feature extractor from a HuggingFace model id or local directory path
save_feature_extractor_to_directory: save a feature extractor instance to a directory as a JSON config file
convert_batch_feature_to_tensors: convert BatchFeature dictionary values to PyTorch or NumPy tensors
serialize_feature_extractor_to_dict: serialize a feature extractor instance to a Python dictionary for inspection or export
register_feature_extractor_for_auto_clas: register a custom feature extractor class with AutoFeatureExtractor for automatic loading
